rows.estimand: Does the fixed encoder recover a public proposal’s stated Motivation more accurately than shared-word matching?
rows.public_wording: On the frozen public-proposal task, the encoder retrieves stated Motivations less accurately than the lexical comparator; the registered encoder advantage is rejected within this task.
